overview: A complete AI-powered interview platform with separate Admin and Candidate panels. Admins add candidates and view detailed analytics. Candidates complete adaptive AI-driven interviews with voice questions, audio recording, and automated evaluation scoring.
features: Admin panel with candidate management and unique link generation
Text and voice question delivery via Web Speech API
Audio-only recording per question via MediaRecorder
AI evaluation: score, strengths, weaknesses, recommendation
Google Sheets sync for candidate data and results
Fully responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile
